correction: SELECT name from [table_name] where [table_name]_id not in ( select [table_name]_id from [subquery_table] group by [table_name]_id having SUM([cost_column]) > [value] )

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that incorrectly uses JOIN statements to combine data from multiple tables and checks for individual costs less than a specific value, when the intended query should use a subquery to find dogs with total treatment costs greater than the specified value.
